originalR2G2Definition.originalRootCause: The generic external-result conversion serialized and redacted arbitrary external values before all resource bounds and JSON-key secret protections were enforced.

The finite contract keeps direct result-boundary correctness and one candidate-bound evidence verification in R2-G2; generic traceability and factory-wiring evidence route to R2-G3; spawn-error handling routes to future hardening.
